title: Cancellation of a quasi-compact immersion through a separated morphism
statement: Let $r:T\to V$ and $s:V\to B$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose $s$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $s\circ r$ is a quasi-compact immersion, with quasi-compactness as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and immersion as in [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then $r$ is a quasi-compact immersion.
